description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder's dateTime method for constructing date/time input fields with various configurations such as setting IDs, values, disabling inputs, date/time/timestamp formats, step sizes, and 12-hour clock options.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilderDatetimeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing date/time input field rendering in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsIdAndValue
methods.description: Tests that the dateTime method correctly sets the ID and value parameters in the renderable output.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsDisabledParameters
methods.description: Tests that the disabled attribute is correctly set when the field is disabled.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsLengthAndMaskForDateType
methods.description: Verifies that length and mask parameters are correctly set for date-type fields.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsLengthForTimeType
methods.description: Verifies length parameters for time-type fields.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsLengthForTimestampType
methods.description: Checks that length parameters are set appropriately for timestamp fields.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsTimeValuesForStepSize1
methods.description: Ensures time dropdown values are correct when step size is 1 second.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsTimeValuesForStepSize3
methods.description: Ensures time dropdown values are correct when step size is 3 seconds.

methods.name: datetimeFieldSetsValuesFor12HourClock
methods.description: Checks that 12-hour clock settings correctly adjust hours and AM/PM flags.
